failure_description: Pump bearing failure due to lack of lubrication
root_cause: Monthly lubrication schedule was missed for 3 cycles
action_plan: Implement a digital maintenance logging system with automated reminders

failure_description: Control system glitch causing emergency shutdown
root_cause: Outdated firmware on PLC unit caused register overflow
action_plan: Update PLC firmware to v2.3 and schedule quarterly firmware audits

failure_description: Leakage detected at flange connection on Pipeline A
root_cause: Gasket degraded after 5000 hours of continuous operation
action_plan: Replace gasket with upgraded material and update maintenance cycle to 4000 hours

failure_description: Conveyor belt snapping during peak production load
root_cause: Belt tensioner misalignment accumulated over 6 months
action_plan: Re-align tensioner system and integrate weekly alignment checks into shift handover

failure_description: Server rack overheating during high traffic periods
root_cause: Air intake filter clogged with dust reducing airflow by 60%
action_plan: Clean all filters monthly and install a high-temperature alarm threshold at 75°C

failure_description: Chemical tank overflow during replenishment procedure
root_cause: Float sensor stuck in DOWN position due to calcium scaling
action_plan: Install redundant ultrasonic level sensor and add daily sensor validation to SOP

failure_description: High vibration detected on turbine B3
root_cause: Loose mounting bolts on the main pedestal due to resonance
action_plan: Retighten all bolts to specification and apply thread-locking compound; add vibration sensor

failure_description: Database connection timeout during weekend backup
root_cause: Network bottleneck on the storage subnet saturated at 400Mbps
action_plan: Upgrade storage network interface card (NIC) to 10GbE and implement QoS policies

failure_description: Valve V-12 failed to open upon remote command
root_cause: Solenoid coil burned out due to sustained overvoltage
action_plan: Replace solenoid, install surge protector, and check upstream voltage regulator

failure_description: Loss of hydraulic pressure in primary press ram
root_cause: Hydraulic hose ruptured after metal fatigue near the elbow fitting
action_plan: Replace hose with reinforced type and install protective sleeve; add pressure drop alarm
